download.local_transport_boundary: First inventory attempt used the scientific Python 3.9 environment and stopped before API import because Kaggle SDK was absent; the empty destination was verified and the exact command succeeded with the system Kaggle interpreter. This is KPF-004 and did not affect kernel artifacts.

error_boundary.exception: RuntimeError: S9 control does not reproduce the accepted two-rank recipe
error_boundary.stage: after complete feature extraction, final-epoch training, checkpoint freeze and accepted baseline identity; during first control/primary score composition

root_cause.accepted_reference: models.bas_candidate_localizer.equal_rank_aggregate computes tie-aware ranks and their mean in float32 PyTorch arithmetic
root_cause.s9_duplicate_path: models.skelex_candidate_marginal.finite_readout computes tie-aware ranks and their mean in NumPy float64, then casts the final vector to float32
root_cause.failed_assertion: np.array_equal on the final float32 control vectors
root_cause.mechanism: Intermediate dtype and rounding order differ even though both paths express the same mathematical percentile-rank formula.
root_cause.why_tests_missed_it: Existing S9 tests covered formula values, singleton/tie behavior and a bounded fixture but did not compare the duplicate NumPy implementation byte-for-byte with the accepted PyTorch aggregate across candidate counts and fused ties.

allowed_to_inherit: the frozen S9 scientific architecture, objective and final-epoch training protocol
the error-free feature/cache/checkpoint provenance as implementation-boundary evidence
the need to use one canonical rank implementation for control and primary composition
not_allowed_to_claim: the saved checkpoint is a terminal audited result

correction_boundary.implementation_only_plan: Route both control and three-way primary through the already accepted equal_rank_aggregate float32 implementation; remove duplicate arithmetic from pair composition, add exhaustive candidate-count/tie byte-identity and winner regression, then repeat full preflight before version 2.
correction_boundary.reason_partial_outputs_not_reused: The in-RAM feature tensors and likelihood vectors were intentionally not exported, and the failed run never froze prediction evidence; version 2 must rerun the exact producer from clean input.
